data.title: Harden advance.lock adoption against pid reuse: per-fire nonce in lock file + ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT marker

data.body: From AS-15 QA review (qa-priya). Current adoption rule: lock.source=='watcher' AND lock.pid == ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT pid. Residual spoof window: a shell carrying a stale ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT whose pid is reused by a NEW live watcher holding a fresh lock would let a manual tick wrongly adopt it and defeat single-flight. Odds are astronomical and the lock is etiquette-not-load-bearing (see advance-watcher.mjs header), hence backlog not blocker. Fix shape: watcher writes a random per-fire nonce into both the lock JSON and the marker (e.g. ADVANCE_TICK_PARENT=watcher:<pid>:<nonce>); step 0 matches pid AND nonce. Touches tickChildEnv + pin test + fire() lock write + advance.md step 0.
